description: User registration endpoint for the GetTheFirst application. GET request returns HTML form with username and password fields. POST request with username and password creates a new user and returns JSON response with userId, userNumber, maybehint, and distance.
notes: GET returns HTML registration form with jQuery AJAX handler. POST endpoint accepts username/password and returns JSON with user information. Response includes 'distance' field which appears to be a game/challenge mechanic. No authentication required. Potential for: password policy bypass, user enumeration, business logic flaws.
